data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the micro-inverter logger.

data_description.port: Local TCP port; 8899 is proposed by default.

manual.description: Enter the local address. Home Assistant will first try to read the numeric SN automatically.
manual.title: Manual connection

discover.description: Select a discovered TSUN device. Its numeric SN and protocol will be detected automatically.
discover.title: Discovered devices

data_description.discovery_network: Private routed network in CIDR notation, for example 192.168.1.0/24.
data_description.port: Local TCP port used to validate candidates.

discover_network.description: No device was found on networks visible to Home Assistant. You can analyze one additional private /24 network, for example a routed VLAN.
discover_network.title: Network to analyze

reconfigure.description: Update the local address without changing the device identity.
reconfigure.title: Reconfigure connection

data_description.error_scan_interval: Interval used before the configured failure threshold is reached.
data_description.failure_threshold: Number of consecutive failures before live readings become unavailable.
data_description.night_scan_interval: Interval used after the threshold, typically when the solar-powered inverter is off at night.
data_description.scan_interval: Interval used after a successful response.

init.description: Configure polling independently for normal operation, temporary errors and night/offline operation.
init.title: Polling settings
